payload.title: Theme the Data Parade newsroom and front end from the dataparade.io landing site
payload.description: Tokens, fonts and logo from the dataparade.io landing app (colour tokens in its design file, Source Serif 4 headings, Inter body, teal brand, logo files). Newsroom: refined-newsprint Kanbus theme with --kb-theme-* overrides in publication/theme.css and a NewsroomLogo. Front end: web/css/site-theme.css and web/projection.json brandHtml and icons. The dataparade.io app itself is not changed.
